string.text: A ready set for the amount of video memory: the Screen Space Shaders pages (Mod Configuration Menu) and the render values tuned for that amount. Apply with another entry chosen overwrites these settings; you can make your own changes again afterwards. Shader quality takes effect only after the game is restarted. The Presets list at the top of the window is a different thing: the game's own quality presets, which change only the base engine settings of this page. If you pick one of those later, it replaces part of this set's values (grass, detail, view distance, sun shafts, volumetric lights, MSAA) and leaves the shader pages alone.
